content:
Took place on September 6th, at Centro Cultural de Vila Flor (Guimarães), the Midterm Conference of the Mobilizing Project “Digital Construction Revolution” – REV@CONSTRUCTION, of which BUILT CoLAB is the coordinator entity!

Under the theme “Digital Construction Revolution in Portugal”, the conference, which marked the return to a face-to-face format, sought to present to the more than 60 participants the main activities developed so far by the project, as well as the future goals.

With the interventions of António Cunha, President of CCDR-N and José Gomes Mendes, President of the Mestre Casais Foundation, as well as Hugo Sousa and João Moutinho from BUILT CoLAB, the event stimulated all participants to reflect on the current state of the sector and the role that digitalisation assumes in the technological revolution of the AEC sector.

If you did not have the opportunity to attend or if you want to see the event again, the session will soon be available on the Youtube channel. The presentation that was made is already available here.
